data.what: Epoch AI, Data on AI models (all models)
Epoch AI, benchmark data with the Epoch Capabilities Index
Ho et al., section3.ipynb at a pinned commit (the code rerun here)
Ho et al.'s dataset, the sheet tab their code reads, as CSV

clusters.method: ability in a cluster minus ability on the model's other benchmarks, each fitted to Epoch's benchmark curves by least squares; drift is the slope of that difference on log10 compute with a date term

not_measurable: any cluster at matched time and budget

eci_fit.form: ECI = a + b (log10 FLOP - 25) + c (years since 2024-01-01), least squares

eci_subsets.note: the rate is not identified: it moves across samples by far more than any one sample's resampling interval

halves.separate_fits_note: model 7 fitted on each bin alone; the scaling exponents are poorly identified on a narrow compute range

terciles.separate_fits_note: model 7 fitted on each bin alone; the scaling exponents are poorly identified on a narrow compute range

ho_rerun.code: section3.ipynb at commit 29c7d852b6cd19ae11bb6662e9c1e61c03b1e4a7, model 7, delta 0.0025, SLSQP from zeros

e1-algo-annual.label: compute-equivalent gain a year at fixed compute implied by the ECI fit on all joined models (multiplier)
e1-algo-annual.note: not identified: the joined sample is mostly open weights and lacks most frontier models, and the rate moves from e1-algo-annual-subset-min to e1-algo-annual-subset-max across samples; it also includes post-training, distillation and inference settings, not only pretraining algorithms

e1-algo-annual-1e24.label: compute-equivalent gain a year at fixed compute, at 1e24 FLOP, from the interaction fit at the sample's median date (multiplier)

e1-algo-annual-1e24-hi.label: gain a year at 1e24 FLOP, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-1e24-lo.label: gain a year at 1e24 FLOP, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-1e26.label: compute-equivalent gain a year at fixed compute, at 1e26 FLOP, from the interaction fit at the sample's median date (multiplier)

e1-algo-annual-1e26-hi.label: gain a year at 1e26 FLOP, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-1e26-lo.label: gain a year at 1e26 FLOP, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-hi.label: compute-equivalent gain a year from the ECI fit, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-lo.label: compute-equivalent gain a year from the ECI fit, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-algo-annual-subset-max.label: highest compute-equivalent gain a year across six samples of the joined models (at or above 1e24.5 FLOP)

e1-algo-annual-subset-min.label: lowest compute-equivalent gain a year across six samples of the joined models (not open weights)

e1-cluster-dev-max.label: largest drift per OOM of compute of one cluster's ability from the model's other benchmarks (knowledge and language)

e1-cluster-dev-max-hi.label: that cluster's drift per OOM, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-cluster-dev-max-lo.label: that cluster's drift per OOM, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-clusters-baselined.label: clusters with any human comparison in the public data, by a search of the archive's columns plus the ledger's GPQA expert bar (none is an organisation at matched budget)
e1-clusters-baselined.note: persuasion has none; AI research and cyber have human time (METR horizons, Cybench first-solve times), not a won-or-lost bar

e1-clusters-drifting.label: of those, clusters whose drift per OOM has a 95% interval that excludes zero

e1-clusters-fitted.label: clusters with at least 10 compute-known models, so a drift on compute can be fitted

e1-clusters-verdict.label: of those, clusters whose comparison gives a won-or-lost bar scored here (GPQA experts, the superforecaster median, GDPval parity)

e1-clusters-with-winner.label: of the scored clusters, those in which any compute-known model beats the human comparison

e1-compute-share.label: share of ECI growth explained by training compute on all joined models, at the ledger's frontier compute growth
e1-compute-share.note: not identified: it moves from e1-compute-share-subset-min to e1-compute-share-subset-max across samples, and the joined sample lacks most frontier models

e1-compute-share-hi.label: share of frontier ECI growth from compute, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-compute-share-lo.label: share of frontier ECI growth from compute, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-compute-share-subset-max.label: highest compute share of ECI growth across the six samples (not open weights)

e1-compute-share-subset-min.label: lowest compute share of ECI growth across the six samples (at or above 1e24.5 FLOP)

e1-drift-per-oom.label: change in the compute-equivalent gain a year per OOM of compute (negative: drift falls with scale, against A3)
e1-drift-per-oom.note: from the interaction fit at the sample's median date; with this value, log10 C + a(C) t falls with log10 C once t exceeds -1 / e1-drift-per-oom years

e1-drift-per-oom-hi.label: drift with scale, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-drift-per-oom-lo.label: drift with scale, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-eci-models.label: models with an Epoch Capabilities Index score

e1-eci-per-oom.label: ECI points gained per order of magnitude of training compute, date held fixed

e1-eci-per-oom-hi.label: ECI points per OOM of compute, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-eci-per-oom-lo.label: ECI points per OOM of compute, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-eci-per-year.label: ECI points gained per year at fixed training compute

e1-eci-slope-change.label: interaction of compute and date: change a year in ECI points per OOM, equally the change per OOM in ECI points gained a year
e1-eci-slope-change.note: negative: capability at fixed compute rose faster for smaller models; its sign is not stable across samples (see eci_subsets)

e1-eci-slope-change-hi.label: change a year in ECI points per OOM, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-eci-slope-change-lo.label: change a year in ECI points per OOM, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-gpqa-acc-compute.label: share of GPQA verdicts against PhD experts the best single training-compute threshold gets right

e1-gpqa-acc-date.label: share of GPQA verdicts the best single release-date threshold gets right

e1-gpqa-acc-effective.label: share of GPQA verdicts the best single effective-compute threshold gets right (compute plus the ECI date term)

e1-gpqa-flips.label: models whose GPQA verdict against PhD experts flips with the reasoning setting at the same training compute

e1-gpqa-models.label: compute-known models with a GPQA Diamond score in Epoch's data

e1-gpqa-overlap-oom.label: training compute of the largest losing model over the smallest winning one on GPQA Diamond, in OOM

e1-gpqa-won.label: of those, models whose best setting beats PhD experts on GPQA Diamond

e1-ho-annual-high.label: yearly effective-compute gain in the highest compute tercile of Ho et al.'s data (multiplier)

e1-ho-annual-high-hi.label: yearly gain, highest compute tercile, 97.5th percentile of resampling

e1-ho-annual-high-lo.label: yearly gain, highest compute tercile, 2.5th percentile of resampling

e1-ho-annual-low.label: yearly effective-compute gain in the lowest compute tercile of Ho et al.'s data (multiplier)

e1-ho-annual-low-hi.label: yearly gain, lowest compute tercile, 97.5th percentile of resampling

e1-ho-annual-low-lo.label: yearly gain, lowest compute tercile, 2.5th percentile of resampling

e1-ho-annual-mid.label: yearly effective-compute gain in the middle compute tercile (multiplier)

e1-ho-bin-edge-hi.label: training compute (6ND) at the edge between the middle and highest terciles

e1-ho-bin-edge-lo.label: training compute (6ND) at the edge between the lowest and middle terciles

e1-ho-halving.label: halving time of compute for fixed perplexity, median of our resampling (their headline is a median)

e1-ho-halving-fit.label: halving time of compute for fixed perplexity, our rerun of Ho et al.'s model 7, point fit

e1-ho-halving-hi.label: halving time, 97.5th percentile of our resampling

e1-ho-halving-lo.label: halving time, 2.5th percentile of our resampling

e1-ho-orig-median.label: halving time, median of their own bootstrap rerun as their notebook seeds it

e1-ho-refit-over-published.label: their bootstrap rerun over their published halving time (1 means it reproduces)

e1-ho-rows.label: results in Ho et al.'s preferred sample, rebuilt from their sheet with their code's filters

e1-ho-top-faster-share.label: share of resamples in which the highest compute tercile progresses faster than the lowest

e1-models.label: models with both an Epoch Capabilities Index score and a training-compute estimate

e1-oos-agg-mae-pp.label: mean absolute error of a model's average benchmark score, from the one-OOM ECI forecast

e1-oos-bench-floor-pp.label: mean absolute error per benchmark score with the model's actual ECI (the index's own floor)

e1-oos-bench-mae-pp.label: mean absolute error per benchmark score, from the one-OOM ECI forecast

e1-oos-bias.label: mean signed error of the one-OOM forecasts (actual minus forecast; negative means overforecast)

e1-oos-bias-1e25.label: mean signed error of the forecast from 1e25 FLOP (actual minus forecast; negative means overforecast)

e1-oos-mae.label: mean absolute error of ECI forecast one OOM of compute beyond the fitting range

e1-oos-mae-1e25.label: mean absolute error of the ECI forecast from 1e25 FLOP to the decade above it

e1-oos-mae-oom.label: the same error as compute-equivalent orders of magnitude (divided by the full fit's slope)

e1-oos-n.label: out-of-sample forecasts one OOM beyond the fitting range (cuts at 1e23 to 1e26 FLOP)

e1-oos-n-1e25.label: models between 1e25 and 1e26 FLOP forecast from a fit on models at or below 1e25 FLOP

e1-oos-unforecast-share.label: share of one-OOM forecasts the actual ECI exceeds the one-sided 95% upper prediction bound (5% if calibrated)

e1-open-share.label: share of the joined models with open weights

e1-spread-mean.label: mean spread (standard deviation) of a model's cluster abilities around its other benchmarks

e1-spread-per-oom.label: change per OOM of compute in the spread of a model's cluster abilities (negative means more even)

e1-spread-per-oom-hi.label: change per OOM in the spread of cluster abilities, 97.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-spread-per-oom-lo.label: change per OOM in the spread of cluster abilities, 2.5th percentile of resampling models

e1-top25-dropped.label: of the 25 models with the highest ECI, those without a public training-compute estimate (left out of every fit)
